author: Bibek Pokhrel
review_text: I’ve had a terrible experience using the eSewa wallet. The app looks good at first, but the service is extremely poor. Transactions often get stuck or fail without proper updates, and the refund process is painfully slow. Customer support is almost useless — they either don’t respond on time or just copy-paste the same answers without solving anything. For a platform that claims to be Nepal’s top digital wallet, the experience is very frustrating.
